raw_text: Mandiant has published a threat brief on the attempted supply chain compromise of India's Defence Research and Development Organisation. The attack leveraged a trusted third-party IT vendor to deploy custom malware through a software update for laboratory management systems. The malware exhibited advanced evasion techniques and established encrypted C2 channels. Attribution analysis indicates a South Asian APT group with nation-state backing. The attack was detected before significant data exfiltration occurred.
